title: crataegus laevigata subsp. vulgaris
intro: Crataegus laevigata subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as Midland hawthorn, is a subspecies of hawthorn tree native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing cholesterol levels, lowering blood pressure, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Midland hawthorn are attributed to its ability to stimulate vasodilation, improve cardiac output, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Midland hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
